params.command: $proxy='C:\Users\Xxkan\.mhw-local-tools\heaven-agent-control-proxy.mjs'; $lines=if(Test-Path $proxy){Get-Content -LiteralPath $proxy}else{@()}; $hits=@($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match 'listen|host|auth|token|secret|header|bearer|7443|7331' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '(?i)(token|secret|key)\s*[:=]\s*["'']?[^"'';\s]+','$1=<REDACTED>' }); $tunnel=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'localtunnel' -and $_.CommandLine -match '7443' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine); $listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7443 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess); [pscustomobject]@{proxy_exists=(Test-Path $proxy);security_lines=$hits;listeners=$listeners;tunnel_processes=$tunnel} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
